# Step - any

`any` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps a list where at least one element matches the predicate.

## Forms

```text
any(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject([1, 5, 3]).any(P.gt(4)).next()   // [1, 5, 3]
```
